lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits, following the curvature of the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary blob clusters, creating a discernible coordinate system across the mid-lateral body.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges run along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition between light-reflecting dorsal edges and shadowed ventral recesses.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of approximately 7-9 high-luminance blobs localized within the central area of its visible silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to the posterior edge and ventral surface of the left pectoral fin and the lower flank.
